page.overview:
What is Bevelle?

Bevelle is a city in Final Fantasy X, Final Fantasy X-2, and Final Fantasy X -Will-. The capital of Spira's dogmatic society; it is initially the home of the Yevon religion and, later, the New Yevon party. Being Yuna's birthplace, it remained her home until her father, High Summoner Braska, defeated Sin. In Final Fantasy X, the Warrior Monks and the fiend Evrae protect the city, and Sin rarely attacks it.

Bevelle was a technological wonder one thousand years ago, surpassing even the city-state of Zanarkand's glories. The novel Final Fantasy X-2.5 ~Eien no Daishō~ explains that at this time Bevelle worshiped a pantheon of deities: Luchera, goddess of war; Kush, goddess of abundance; Anli, god of travelers; Ifarnal, god of beauty; Sloan, god of vengeance; Alb, god of workers; Guard, god of the Farplane; Valm, god of order; Kanaela, goddess of the moon; and Meiyoh, god of the sun. The leader of Bevelle was a Summoner who declared the leader of Zanarkand, Yu Yevon, and his daughter Yunalesca to be heretics who had strayed away from the gods.

The escalating hostilities between the city-states culminated in the Machina War, and Bevelle held the advantage with its machina weapons. Though it developed the mobile weapon Vegnagun, they could not use it as Vegnagun was unable to tell friend from foe, and it was hidden away underneath Bevelle. During the war both sides used both machina and summoners, though the summoners of Bevelle were not willing soldiers. As soon as someone was shown to have a talent for summoning they were recruited and trained from youth. Summoners and their guardians disposed of their old identities by taking the name of one of Bevelle's gods as their new name.

Zanarkand's leader, Yu Yevon, gathered the Zanarkand survivors and turned them into fayth all but for his daughter Yunalesca and her husband, Zaon. Yu Yevon used the newly-created fayth to conjure a dream world parallel of Zanarkand at the height of its glory, setting it far out to sea, never to be discovered by mortals.
